categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Veichi Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in industrial automation, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of industrial control products including variable frequency drives (VFDs), servo systems, and control systems such as PLCs and motion controllers. The company also extends its business into emerging sectors like robotics, new energy, and medical equipment, offering products like hollow cup motors, frameless torque motors, hydrogen production power supplies, photovoltaic energy storage inverters, and surgical power systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced core technologies including motor V/F scalar control, vector control, high-frequency injection control, motor parameter identification, PWM control, servo control, and power semiconductor device control. It employs matrix organizational structures for R&D, integrating software, hardware, and structural design with rigorous testing and quality control. Production combines stock and order-based manufacturing, with in-house PCBA, sheet metal, assembly, software programming, and aging tests, supplemented by outsourced non-core processes like surface spraying and wire processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Veichi Electric serves a broad range of industries including heavy industry, light industry, high-end equipment manufacturing, new energy (photovoltaic, energy storage, hydrogen), robotics, medical devices, metallurgy, mining, shipbuilding, petrochemical, port cranes, and smart manufacturing sectors. Its customers include industrial automation equipment manufacturers and downstream manufacturing plants, with a focus on providing customized system solutions to top-tier clients in these industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a strong domestic presence across 21 major cities supported by 314 distributors and direct sales teams. It has expanded its international footprint with subsidiaries and warehouses in India, Hong Kong, and overseas markets, achieving significant overseas revenue growth, particularly in Southeast Asia and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Veichi Electric operates mainly in the midstream segment of the industrial automation supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of industrial control hardware and software products. It procures raw materials and components, performs core manufacturing processes internally, and delivers finished products to equipment manufacturers and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on breakthroughs in motor control algorithms, power electronics, servo systems, and digital energy solutions. It actively develops products for robotics, AI-enabled inspection, new energy (including hydrogen and energy storage), and high-end equipment sectors. Digital transformation and smart manufacturing are key strategic themes, with ongoing projects in intelligent factories, digital platforms, and AI integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of industrial automation equipment including VFDs, servo systems, PLCs, and digital energy products. The company employs a mixed sales model combining direct sales to large industry clients and distributor-based sales across regions. It also offers customized system solutions and after-sales services, with payment terms including bank transfers, acceptance bills, and letters of credit.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Veichi Electric is a leading domestic player in China's industrial automation market, ranking fourth among domestic brands in the low-voltage VFD segment with a 2.49% market share and holding a 1.96% share in the servo systems market. It competes against international giants like Siemens, ABB, and Mitsubishi, leveraging its local brand advantages, cost competitiveness, and customized solutions to gain market share amid accelerating domestic substitution of imports.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.64 billion, a 25.7% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 245 million, up 28.42%. R&D investment accounted for 13.25% of revenue, reflecting a 32.71% increase in R&D spending. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.07 billion, growing 20.82% from the previous year, with a net asset value of RMB 2.09 billion. Cash flow from operations improved significantly, indicating strong operational growth and financial health.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Veichi Electric emphasizes high-performance, high-quality, and high-reliability industrial automation products with strong local brand advantages. Its competitive differentiation lies in comprehensive product lines covering control, drive, and execution layers, advanced proprietary technologies, and the ability to provide customized, scenario-based system solutions. The company’s focus on innovation, digital transformation, and integration of AI and smart manufacturing technologies enables it to meet diverse and evolving customer needs, supporting manufacturing upgrades and import substitution.
